correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of all 24-arc directed path forests gives 1816 nonempty faces, f=(24,192,616,744,240) and 6408 face-poset covers. Independently checked 843-pair acyclic matching, critical (1,0,4,93,32), and mod-two boundary ranks (23,169,444,208). Rebuilt signed antipodal chains and projected mod-1009 ranks giving + and - eigendimensions H2:(2,1), H3:(49,43), H4:(12,20). The inspected original integer Morse elimination has one primitive rank-one 3-to-2 differential and no top differential, yielding free groups Z^3,Z^92,Z^32; modular sharpness follows sums equal rational total ranks.
